full_prompt_en: A square color photograph shows an empty paved street ending at a low sea wall under an almost white overcast sky. A weathered building runs up the entire left edge, its blue-gray plaster mottled with darker stains and rubbed pale patches. Near the lower left, a narrow dark wooden door opens onto the sidewalk. Farther up, a small projecting balcony and the angled roof eave cast compact shadows across the wall. A drainpipe marks the building's front corner. The street and sidewalk extend from the bottom of the frame toward the far wall, their cracked concrete and seams forming quiet receding lines. An old slender lamp post stands just beyond the building near the center-left. Its small fittings are dark against the bright empty sky, creating a vertical accent between the heavy left wall and open right side. Across the middle distance, a low gray parapet runs horizontally, separating the pavement from a faint pale blue expanse of water. The distant horizon is barely visible where sea and sky meet. A subtle warm pink tint hovers close to that line, but most of the view stays in cool blue, gray, and off-white. On the right, the open asphalt occupies a broad plain area with only a few soft wear marks and shallow changes in tone. No people, vehicles, or legible signs appear. Diffused daylight comes through the cloud cover, leaving soft small shadows beneath the balcony and eave, with no hard directional highlights. The photograph keeps the grain and slight weathering of the surfaces visible while allowing the bright distance to remain nearly blank. The overall composition is spare and still, balancing the textured vertical building with an empty street, low horizontal barrier, and pale open air.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色照片呈现空无一人的铺装街道，街道在低矮海堤处结束，上方是几乎发白的阴天天空。一栋风化建筑沿整个左缘竖起，蓝灰色灰泥墙面斑驳着较深污渍和磨浅的补丁。左下方一扇窄小深色木门朝人行道开口。上方一个小小凸出阳台和倾斜屋檐在墙面投下紧凑阴影。一根落水管标出建筑前角。街道与人行道从画面底部延向远处矮墙，开裂混凝土和接缝形成安静的后退线条。一根老式细街灯柱站在建筑后方、中央偏左处，小小灯具在明亮空白天空前呈深色，成为厚重左墙与开放右侧之间的垂直重音。中远处一道低矮灰色护墙水平延伸，将铺装地面与隐约的浅蓝水面隔开。海与天相接处，远地平线几乎看不清。那条线附近浮着微弱的暖粉色，但大部分景象保持冷蓝、灰和灰白。右侧开放的沥青地占据宽阔而朴素的面积，仅有少量柔和磨痕和浅浅色调变化。画面没有人物、车辆或可读标牌。散射日光透过云层落下，阳台和屋檐下只有小片软影，没有硬朗的定向高光。照片保留表面颗粒与轻微风化，也让明亮远方近乎空白。整体构图简洁而静止，以有肌理的垂直建筑平衡空旷街道、低矮水平护墙和淡色开放空气。
style_prompt_en: The color photography uses a level, patient viewpoint and large areas of low-contrast negative space. Cool blue-gray, chalky white, muted charcoal, and faint warm undertones make a narrow, subdued palette. One textured vertical mass is set beside a broad pale field, while thin upright accents and a low horizontal divide quietly organize the emptiness. Natural light is fully diffused, flattening cast shadows but leaving gradual tonal shifts and small sheltered dark areas. Weathered grain, worn pigment, seams, and fine surface marks are recorded plainly, without turning them into dramatic distress. Straight structural edges remain legible, while the bright distance fades gently and can nearly dissolve into the background. The framing leaves ordinary visual pauses around the main forms rather than filling every corner. The overall effect is reserved and contemplative, with restrained color, soft light, and precise spatial intervals giving the image its character.
style_prompt_zh: 这种彩色摄影采用平视而耐心的视点，以及大面积低反差负空间。冷蓝灰、粉白、低饱和炭灰和微弱暖色底调构成狭窄而克制的色谱。一块有肌理的竖向大体块置于宽阔浅色区域旁，细窄竖向重音和低矮水平分界安静地组织空旷感。自然光完全散射，使投影变平，却保留渐进的明度变化与遮蔽处的小块深色。风化颗粒、磨损颜料、接缝与细小表面痕迹被平实记录，而非夸张成戏剧化破败。笔直的结构边缘仍清晰，明亮远处则柔和褪去，几乎与背景融合。取景让主要形体周围留有普通而自然的视觉停顿，没有填满每个角落。整体效果含蓄、沉思，由克制色彩、柔光和准确的空间间隔形成性格。
theme_en: An empty seaside street beside a weathered blue wall under a pale overcast sky
theme_zh: 淡淡阴天下，褪色蓝墙旁空无一人的海边街道
name: Guido Guidi
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
